messages.subject: Re: scale_fill_gradient2 warning
parts:
I can verify that, and probably explain why. I get the same color "skewing", but it's because the midpoint is set to 0. Try adjusting it to the mean of the range of that particular column and the colors will reflect more of what you want. 

ggplot(A, aes(x=V1, y=V2, fill=V3)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", high="red", midpoint = mean(range(A$V3)))

ggplot(A, aes(x=V1, y=V2, fill=V3)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue", high="red", midpoint = mean(range(A$V3)))
